values.DataCenterNotes: Pipeline and Gas Journal reported in July 2025 that Northwest Pipeline's FERC application for the Wild Trail Project says the project was developed in response to strong demand to serve coal-to-gas power conversions, data centers, and industrial loads. No specific data center or plant is named.

verifications.note: Article on the Wild Trail Project says the application cites demand from coal-to-gas power conversions, data centers, and industrial loads.

records.researcher_notes: A trade press article on the company's federal filing lists data centers among the reasons for the project. The company's own page and the federal notice do not say it. No named data center was found.

ledger.note: Searched the Mustang Express Pipeline with data center and power terms. The only anchor shipper is Sempra for Port Arthur LNG phase two. No data center or power plant tie was found.

Searched the Tioga Pathway Expansion with data center terms. National Fuel talks about data center interest company-wide and names the Shippingport Lateral for a data center, but that is a different project. No tie to Tioga Pathway was found.

The expansion serves the Southwestern Public Service Gaines County Generating Station, a 1,160 megawatt gas plant. Searched for data center load tied to that plant in the Power magazine article, the trade press on the pipeline, and Xcel news. Xcel talks about data center growth company-wide, but no source ties this plant to data centers.
Searched the Kelso-Beaver Reliability Project. It links storage to the Portland General Electric Beaver plant for winter reliability. No source mentions data centers for the project or the plant.

The line serves the 400 megawatt Western Farmers Electric Cooperative Hugo plant expansion. Searched the trade press, local news, and Rural Development materials. They cite load growth and Southwest Power Pool rule changes. No data center was named.

Searched the Pelican Pipeline with data center terms. Sources describe Haynesville gas takeaway to the Gillis Hub and LNG. Louisiana data center gas plants are in separate coverage with no link to this line.

Searched the Pennyrile Energy Corridor with data center terms. Named customers are Fort Campbell and a Novelis aluminum plant in Guthrie. The Paducah data center campus is outside the area, and no source ties it to the line.
A trade press article on the FERC application says data centers are among the reasons for the project. No named data center or plant.
